name: citebase
description: Citebase: get cited by AI. The open-source agent that gets your brand recommended, cited and featured by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. It measures where AI stands on your brand today, finds the gaps on live data, and plans the pages, press, partnerships and outreach that close them. One sign-in with Apify; every data call shows its price first and runs under a spending cap and a daily ceiling, and a measurement loop re-checks whether your changes moved AI recommendations.

max_run_usd.title: Max cost per data run (USD)
max_run_usd.description: Runs above this need your explicit approval each time.

daily_send_cap.title: Daily outreach send cap
daily_send_cap.description: Maximum outreach emails the agent may send per day after your approval.

daily_spend_usd.title: Daily Apify spend ceiling (USD)
daily_spend_usd.description: Citebase blocks new data runs once the caps of today's runs add up to this amount.

allowed_actors.title: Extra allowed Apify Actors
allowed_actors.description: Comma-separated owner/name entries (or owner/*) Citebase may run besides khadinakbar/*. Leave empty unless you have checked their pricing.
